SECTION I . Title 17 of the Municipal Code ofChicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,

is hereby amended by changing all the B3-1 Community Shopping District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No.l 1-M in the area bounded by


The alley next north of and parallel to West Irving Park Road; a line 261.94
feet east of and parallel to North Narraganset Avenue; West Irving Park Road; and
a line 199.44 feet east of and parallel to North Narraganset Avenue.


to those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.


SECTION2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.
